details:
There are things i am not happy with the way how Community Labs is made.

Might looks like feature request, but because some things are unchanged and unwanted actions happened, i will say the system is bugged. Some features are missing to avoid it.

- 1: Is world really safe?

I was trying out world today and when world entered, there is no floor below me, so i am in endless fall. The menu panel should help me to eject me, but no.... i cant control it. So i am forced to exit VRC.

Example world: https://vrchat.com/home/world/wrld_8a5f6013-a6cf-459d-ae40-e0ff54ad61d5 

(might removed later, this is example for now) 

The world seems broken, and it's never updated since Oct 2022. Just got 300 visits, BAM! it goes in NEW worlds listing. This is serious problem, why APPROVE it.... this is totally wrong.

Yes, the world is not safe, but reporting system is too much hidden away with some clicks, you can't report it on website (it's only ingame) and many people didn't even report it as broken world.

Also there is no internal safety check in VRC if world has really floor below or not. This should help auto-eject me out of the world for example.

There is something missing in Community Labs system: we can't report EASY it's unsafe world. And no internal security checks against endless fall. This should detected. Or make menu system more solid against fast motions like free fall, so i can still click on it. Or add special escape button combination to auto exit and go to home world. Safety solutions enough.

- 2: Old worlds problem

Second problem is weird problem. I see sometimes old worlds get approved, and they are over 3 months old. It even happens i visit "new" world which is not updated for more than 1 year, the high record was more than 2 years not updated. Very old worlds get approved and goes as "NEW" world in the list.

New world? Bullshit. Why is 2 year old world suddenly marked as new world? This is exactly the problem the system is not working correctly.

The solution is extremely easy. Don't let old worlds (based on Update date) go in NEW world listing if they are more than 3 months old. Actually 1 month time is better. Because good and interesting worlds get pretty easy 300 visits in 1 month. Good worlds can get easy 100 visits each day, so 1 month is just GOOD enough to give approve and can marked as NEW world. ONE month is good enough.

The problem right now there is no date check in the system, and will just simply flag all worlds, who get 300 visits, as NEW world. That is crazy. Use only 1 rule "300 visitors" is big mistake. And this mistake is in the code for YEARS, i say again, this is still unchanged rule for years until now. There is no second rule added. No rule about minimal age check of the updated world.

The solution is simple: don't put them in NEW world listing. Just roll it away as normal listing, nothing special. Because world is already too old. You can remove flag as Community Labs, sure. But not as "new" world.

- 3: Where is reporting system?

Strange question. Of course we have reporting system. But... the proof why unsafe worlds get approved means something is wrong with reporting system. It's not easy to report it. Maybe too much clicks needed to report it. 

VRC has no upvote / downvote system, which is much easier to click on it. Maybe most people thinks report system is for very bad worlds, with stolen stuff or so. Illegal stuff in world. But broken worlds? 

They need reported for sure, but most people don't report it. They just ignore the world and step to next world. Because it's just too much work for some poeple. Maybe too much steps needed. And website has no link below the world page to report it. I think it was removed since Website upgrade.

So yeah, we need change the report system to make it easier. With some direct buttons for example, instead step by step with questions and words. Direct buttons might useful than you think.

With all respects, i know creators want see worlds get approved and go to New world. 

But this will show also which worlds are interested and which not. Creators should not beg why their home world is not approved after many months. The answer is so easy: we have too many home worlds and many worlds are also just personal, so we're mostly not interested to visit them. Many have also same world design. That is why it's not worth to visit world if look is not unique and all looks exactly same.

This is long text, but i am kinda annoyed at current system. I still not understand a single cent why old worlds get approved and moved to NEW worlds listing. Even unsafe worlds get approved! It's really crazy and totally nuts, almost useless actually, because there is just one rule for everything. No matter which age or safety.

Come on, this can done better. And imagine this problem actually exists for YEARS. Year ago i saw same problem, and still not changed today. So i am complaining here right now, even i type way too long text here.
title: Community Labs system need update. Here is why.
